part.label: Angled Sensor Mount With Inherited Rotation
part.description: A base plate with a support tipped 20 degrees off vertical, and a small mounting pad that sits flush on the support's tipped face (inheriting its rotation) instead of remaining axis-aligned, with a mounting hole drilled perpendicular through the pad (also inheriting the rotation) rather than straight down in world Z.

components.description: Tipped 20 degrees off vertical (about X); a component resting on it needs the same tilt to sit flush, not just the right anchor position.
Sits flush on the support's tipped top face by inheriting its rotation, instead of resting at the correct anchor point but at the wrong (world-aligned) orientation.

features.description: Drilled perpendicular to the pad's (tipped) top face by inheriting its rotation, instead of straight down in world Z.
